import numpy as np
N=25
r=np.arange(-N,N+1)
A,B=np.meshgrid(r,r)
A=A.ravel();B=B.ravel()
m=(A!=0)|(B!=0);A=A[m];B=B[m]
def T(t,nu=6):
    s=np.sqrt(t.imag)
    z=(A+t*B)/s
    a=np.abs(z)
    k=a<6
    z=z[k]
    X=z[:,None];Y=z[None,:]
    d=np.abs(X-Y);ax=np.abs(X)*np.abs(Y)
    with np.errstate(divide='ignore'):
        v=(ax*d)**(-nu)
    v[~np.isfinite(v)]=0
    return v.sum()
for t in [np.exp(1j*np.pi/3),1j,0.25+1j*1.0,0.5+1j*1.0,0.5+1.5j,0.3+1j*1.0,1.2j,0.5+0.9j]:
    if abs(t)>=1-1e-9: print(t,T(t))
